_comment: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE ONLY. Copy to profile.json (gitignored) and fill with your own confirmed facts. Never invent qualifications. Leave unknown fields blank or omit them.

work_authorization.note: Leave blank in public copies. Fill privately via secure form when a site asks. Never invent status.

salary_expectations.note: Private. Answer only through a secure form when a live application asks. Never invent a number for the user.

experience_summary.title: Example Job Title
highlights: Did an example thing with measurable outcome X

resume_file_hint: Keep the real resume under a private bot path or vault — never in this public repo.
optional_demographics_policy: Never pre-select EEO/demographic/self-ID answers. The owner chooses every optional demographic field, or leaves it blank.
